# **The Problem**

There can be difficulty in finding a suitable peer tutor for specific courses since any information about students willing to tutor are usually split across social media platforms and word of mouth, and this can be much more troublesome depending on the courses they need tutoring for. As well, any students who are capable and willing to tutor don’t really have any centralized way to advertise their availability.

## **Users**

* Students who want to find a peer tutor that has both the qualification and availability that matches their current academic needs.  
* Students who want to teach other students but do not have an easy way of reaching out to potential students 

---

# **Requirements Summary**

| ID | Requirements | Priority |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **FR-1** | Create a tutor profile listing courses and availability | **Must** |
| **FR-2** | Search for tutors by filtering desired courses and time | ***Must \- MVP*** |
| **FR-3** | View tutor profile and see availability, what courses the tutor teaches, and reviews | **Must**  |
| **FR-4** | Send/Receive tutoring requests | **Must** |
| **FR-5** | Leave a review | *Should* |
| **NFR-1** | When a student searches for a tutor, the search results will appear within 5 seconds on campus Wi-FI | *Should* |
| **NFR-2** | A tutoring request will be notified to tutor within 10 seconds on campus Wi-Fi | *Should* |
| **NFR-3** | A new user should be able to search for a tutor based on a course in less than 3 steps upon opening the app | *Should* |
| **NFR-4** | No duplicate profile or review is created when you try to create a new profile or review | **Must** |
| **NFR-5** | When accessing a profile, user must authenticate with their password or id | **Must** |

# **Testing**

| ID | Scenario | Expected | Result |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **(FR-1)** | A tutor profile is created with valid details, courses, and availability. | The profile is created and the details are saved properly | Passed |
| **(FR-1)** | Tutor attempts to create a profile without any courses | The tutor is prompted to select at least one courses, and the profile is not created | Passed |
| **(FR-1)**  | Tutor creates a profile with multiple courses | The profile is created and all courses that the tutor selected can be seen | Passed |
| **(FR-1)** | Tutor creates a profile without adding/ listing any availability or time slots | The tutor is prompted to add at least one available day for them to teach | Passed |
| **(FR-1)** | Tutor edits their profile | The profile will be updated accordingly and no duplicate profile will be created | Failed |
| **(FR-2)** | Student searches for Tutor with the listed course: Mathematics | Tutor with Mathematics listed will be shown to the student while those without will be hidden | Passed |
| **(FR-2)** | Student searches for a tutor who is available during: Monday | Tutor with Monday available will be shown while those who do not will be hidden | Passed |
| **(FR-2)** | Student searches for tutor with the listed courses: Mathematics, and is available during: Monday | Tutor with Monday available and Mathematics listed in their profile will be shown while those that do not match these criteria will not be shown | Passed |
| **(FR-2)** | Student searches for courses and availability with no matching tutors | ‘No tutors were found’ will be displayed and no tutor profiles will be seen by the student | Passed |
| **(FR-2)** | Student clears the search filters | The search results will be updated to reflect the current criterias | Passed |
| **(FR-3)** | Student open a tutor profile | The profile will be displayed along with the details the tutor has listed | Passed |
| **(FR-3)** | Student views a tutor profile with reviews | The reviews will be displayed to the student | Passed |
| **(FR-3)** | Student views a tutor profile with no reviews | No reviews will be displayed to the student | Passed |
| **(FR-4)** | Student sends a tutoring request | The request is created and will be sent upon the student’s confirmation | Passed |
| **(FR-4)** | The tutor receives the request | The tutoring request will be sent to the tutor and the student can not send another request | Passed |
| **(FR-4)** | The tutor accepts the request | The student will be notified that the request is accepted, they will be able to contact the tutor and they cannot send another request | Passed |
| **(FR-4)** | The tutor declines the request | The student will be notified that the request is declined and the student will not be able to send another request for the next 5 minutes | Failed (While the request will be declined, it does not notify the student and the student can still send the request within the 5 minutes.) |
| **(FR-4)** | The student attempts to send another request to the tutor | The request will not be sent and the student will be notified of this | Failed (Request was still sent) |
| **(FR-4)** | The student attempts to send another request after being declined but 5 minutes have not passed | The request will not be sent and the student will be notified of this and the remaining time until they can send another request | Failed ( As stated before, the request was still sent.) |
| **(FR-5)** | Eligible student submits a valid review | The review is saved and displayed on the profile | Passed |
| **(FR-5)** | Student attempts to submit a review without writing anything down | The review is submitted and the review is written as (no comment) | Passed |
| **(FR-5)** | Student attempts to submit a review to the same tutor | A duplicate review will be created | Failed  |
| **(FR-5)** | The student views the profile after writing the review | The review will be seen by the student | Passed |

# **AI-First Reflection**

In this project, we used: ChatGPT and Claude AI.  
We first used ChatGPT to help create our first project: BusBuddy, however we had to change to a different project due to the fact we did not understand the problem and it was shallow at best. ChatGPT was also used to correct any grammar mistakes and fix wordings to sound much more professional. AI was also used in the layout for UI/UX to help us design the UI to place the FRs where the user can easily spot it and won’t be confused when navigating our website. ChatGPT was also in the Golden Thread Table for the design and implementation section to explain the definition of both of these.  
As for the prototype, we had used Claude AI in its creation. It was 100% made with Claude. We had given the listed FRs to Claude AI and told it to make a website based on what we had given it. While Claude had created a prototype that covered our FRs, it had only covered what we had given it.  
Example: In the search function, the FR stated that the search is filtered based on courses and availability, so it does search for the name of the tutor.

# **Golden Thread Table**

| Problem | Requirement | Design  | Implementation | Test scenario/Acceptance criteria |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Students have trouble in finding a peer tutor | FR-2 | Screen search \+ filters wireframe | Search function \+ course and time filter | Students will only see tutors who have the matching courses and time listed in their profile ✓  |
| Tutors need a way to reach out to other students and advertise their services | FR-1 | Profile creation overlay | Create profile \+ save tutor details | Create profile with courses and availability \+ profile is saved and displayed correctly ✓  |
| Students need a way to know if the tutor is qualified or not | FR-3 | Courses, availability data model \+ review overlay | Profile page displayed detailing listed courses, availability, and reviews | Open profile → The details listed by the tutor (Courses and availability) \+ Reviews will be displayed ✓   |
| Students want a way to request a tutoring session from a tutor | FR-4 | Tutoring request overlay \+ request status flow | Send request \+ receive and respond to requests | Students send request → Tutor receives the request and can accept or decline it ✓   |
| Students need a way to share feedback about tutors | FR-5 | Review submission overlay | Review form \+ save/display functionality | Submit review → review appears on tutor profile ✓   |
